revisions.note: Numbers published before this date (e.g. macro-F1 0.9592, Scam recall 92.4%) were measured against the previous labels and are not directly comparable to numbers measured after it.
revisions.what: Relabelled 7 rows after blind human review of Scam-labelled messages carrying institutional/telco wording (5 Scam->Spam, 2 Scam->Ham). All 7 came from the raw phone inbox and were real messages from a school or telco that the rule cascade had labelled Scam.
revisions.why: Evaluating against labels known to be wrong reports a wrong number in both directions. The review was blind: the reviewer did not see which rows the model had predicted correctly, so the corrections cannot have been tuned to flatter the score.

warning: This holdout set only protects models trained AFTER it was created. The checkpoint deployed 2026-07-29 and the 2026-08-17 retraining candidate were both trained on the full pool before this split existed and were almost certainly trained on some of these rows -- do not evaluate either of them against this holdout and report the result as a clean, never-seen test. The first model this is valid for is the next one trained from this point on.
